candidates: When reviewing changes to `.gitattributes`, flag any broad glob (such as `* -text`) that disables Git line-ending normalization for all files. Require either: (a) an inline comment explaining why global normalization disabling is necessary (e.g., the repo intentionally contains mixed binary/generated files that must preserve native line endings), or (b) replacement of the broad pattern with targeted globs scoped only to the file types that actually need it (e.g., `*.png -text`, `*.jar -text`, `generated/** -text`), to prevent cross-platform line-ending inconsistencies for contributors on different operating systems.
